About Kathu

Kathu is the district of Phuket that lies between Patong on the west coast and Phuket Town, so it is inland rather than on the beach; Patong Beach is the nearest sea. We list two completed condominium projects here, Dcondo Reef Kathu and The Origin Kathu-Patong, with advertised starting prices from about THB 2.3 million.

For Dcondo Reef the developer's site gives about 2.6 km to the Phuket campus of Prince of Songkla University, about 3.5 km to Central Phuket, about 7 km to Patong Beach, and 5-10 minutes to Bangkok Hospital Phuket; the airport is about 32 km (40 minutes) by car. The Origin Kathu-Patong is placed by its developer between Patong Beach and the Old Town; its own distances are not published yet, so ask us for travel times.

Why buyers choose Kathu

  • Patong about 15 minutes over the hill
  • Loch Palm and Red Mountain golf courses
  • Kathu waterfall and green hills
  • Lower prices than beach areas

Lifestyle and amenities

Kathu is a local town with markets, schools and restaurants, plus golf courses and quiet residential lanes. Phuket Town and Patong are both within a short drive.

Beaches and surroundings

Kathu has no beach of its own; Patong Beach is the nearest, about 7 km away according to our project data.

Rental demand in Kathu

Kathu is mainly a long-term rental market. Tenants include people working in Patong and Phuket Town and families who prefer a quieter inland location.

Long-term rentals

Workers and families look for affordable condos and houses with easy access to Patong and Phuket Town.

Short-term holiday rentals

Limited, mainly golfers and budget travellers.

Suitable property types

Affordable condos, townhouses and houses.

Advantages and limitations

Advantage: affordable, central location. Limitations: no beach and little holiday demand.

General market observations, not verified statistics. No rental income or occupancy is guaranteed; developer-advertised returns are not market results.

Rental and investment in Kathu

Kathu attracts buyers looking for affordable property and long-term rental near Patong and Phuket Town.

Typical investor profiles

Long-term rental investors and owner-occupiers.

Risks to consider

Lower rents than tourist areas; limited holiday demand.

Ownership costs

Common fees, maintenance and periods between tenants.

Kathu: frequently asked questions

Where is Kathu in Phuket?

Kathu is an inland district between Patong and Phuket Town; Patong itself is part of Kathu district.

How far is Kathu from Patong Beach?

Our project data puts Kathu projects about 7 km from Patong Beach, roughly 15 minutes by car over the hill.

Are there golf courses in Kathu?

Yes, Loch Palm and Red Mountain golf courses are in Kathu.

Is Kathu a good place to rent out property?

Kathu is mainly a long-term rental market for people working in Patong and Phuket Town; holiday demand is limited.

How far is Kathu from the airport?

Our project data gives about 32 to 33 km to Phuket International Airport.

How much does property in Kathu cost?

Advertised starting prices for projects in Kathu run from ฿2,290,000 to ฿2,450,000 (2 of 2 projects publish a price). These are lowest advertised prices; ask us to confirm current availability.
